interpretation: Test maintained Andean field management on the existing dated cultivated footprint. Covey documents preimperial terraces, canals, dry farming and local organization; later imperial projects remain excluded.

assessment.range_role: Regional analogue using the same common management-score conversion and uncertainty width as Parisis/Shuntian. Not a measured local score or fitted population target.

land_contract: Restore only reconstructed LUH2 current cropland truncated by the crop-mixture mask, retaining baseline accessible fields and displacing existing livelihoods. No new generic cultivated fraction or later terrace-area total.
water_contract: No additional water-served hectares assigned: the available preimperial terrace descriptions do not quantify a province-wide irrigated fraction. The management score records maintained systems but this diagnostic grants no irrigation capacity bonus.
known_unresolved: Pisaq has no nonzero crop-density evidence in the cached crop model. Restoring field hectares cannot create a crop yield; report this coverage failure independently of simulation survival.
LUH2 allocation and HYDE belong to related evidence; this is not independent historical validation.
Local management and cultivated extent remain uncertain; this regional analogue does not imply uniform attested adoption.
exclusions: Do not backdate imperial maize yields or later estate hectares.
Do not use population to allocate land, management or density.
